Define audience, outcome, duration, platform/aspect, narrative beats, shot grammar, pacing, visual continuity, motion language, voice/music/SFX, captions, and brand constraints.

Review full renders plus key frames for pacing, cuts, legibility, caption timing, audio levels, clipping, motion continuity, encoding, and target-platform dimensions; test beginning/end and seek points explicitly.

The result must not take the tempting shortcut prohibited by this skill: Do not overuse motion presets, let captions obscure primary content, rely on draft-preview timing as final render proof, or use copyrighted media without appropriate rights.

Every material completion claim must map to observable evidence (video-production decision and boundary evidence; Representative verification results or explicit unavailable checks; Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale; Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification), with simulated, unavailable, inferred, stale, or unresolved evidence labeled rather than converted into certainty.
